First listed 2026-08-03 · episode or wrap

250 Years of American Capitalism: Hamilton, the GFC, & the AI Boom | The Real Eisman Playbook Ep 71

Adrian Wooldridge surveys American capitalism from Hamilton through industrialization and financial crises. The main investment lesson is that transformative infrastructure need not reward its investors. Eisman independently challenges the book GFC account, emphasizing leverage rather than housing policy alone. Primary commission evidence supports that emphasis while limiting stronger claims about a single regulatory cause and a panic-free counterfactual. Long-run AI and institutional analogies remain unproven; the claimed Roosevelt inauguration timing is contradicted by a contemporaneous record.
